info.title: CloudThinker Public API
info.description: Public API v1. Every path names its workspace. IDs are UUIDs. Lists page with `limit` and `cursor`. Writes take `Idempotency-Key`. A write runs at once when the token's scopes allow it. Clients ask their person first for operations marked `x-confirm`.

post.summary: Ask CloudThinker: start an agent run, or continue a conversation.
post.description: Starts an agent run with your rights and returns at once with `status: pending`. Poll `chat.runs.get` until `status` is `succeeded`, `failed`, `cancelled` or `required_approval`. Runs cost credits. Agent tool calls inside the run go through the workspace Approval mode.

get.summary: Read the calling token: user, scopes, allowed workspaces, expiry.
get.description: The only operation without a workspace in its path. Needs no scope. Returns only the caller's own token facts.

metadata.title: Read the calling token
metadata.sidebarTitle: Read the calling token

x-mint.content: **Scope:** none. Any valid token can call this.

bearer.description: CloudThinker token: a personal access token `ct_pat_…` (fine-grained scopes, created in Settings) or an OAuth access token `ct_oat_…` (1 hour, from the OAuth flow). Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Scopes have the form `module:resource:read|write`; write includes read.

WorkspaceId.name: workspace_id
WorkspaceId.description: Workspace to act in. Every call names it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique per logical write. A retry with the same key and body returns the first result.

IdempotencyKeyOptional.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyOptional.description: Unique per logical write. A retry with the same key and body returns the first result.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The `ETag` from the last GET. A mismatch returns 412.

X-Request-ID.description: Request id. Quote it to support.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag of the returned resource. Send it as `If-Match`.

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

Forbidden.description: The token lacks the scope, or your role lacks the permission.

NotFound.description: Not found in this workspace, or you are not a member.

Conflict.description: The Idempotency-Key was reused with a different body, or the first call is still running.

PreconditionFailed.description: If-Match does not match the current ETag. Read the resource again.

ValidationError.description: A parameter or body field is invalid. See `error.field_errors`.
